samples.question: This picture shows dark gray wires, one green square, one purple square and eight identical orange pads. Every wire runs only horizontally or vertically, and no wire ever touches or crosses another wire. Some wires contain a visible blank break; a break means the wire is cut there and nothing passes through it. A pad is supplied by a colored square when you can follow dark gray wire from that square to that pad without ever crossing a break or jumping a blank space. Each pad can be supplied by at most one square, and some pads are supplied by neither. How long the wires are, how many breaks each network has, where the pads sit and which side of the picture a square is on do not matter; only the number of pads each square supplies counts. Which colored square supplies more orange pads? Answer green or purple.
